article.headline: Delaware State beats Cheyney (PA) 90-70
article.description: — Nasir Muhammad had 19 points in Delaware State’s 90-70 victory over Cheyney (PA) on Tuesday.
article.story: DOVER, Del. -- — Nasir Muhammad had 19 points in Delaware State’s 90-70 victory over Cheyney (PA) on Tuesday. Muhammad had seven assists and three steals for the Hornets (2-3). Joshua Obiora scored 15 points and added eight rebounds. Dean Shepherd shot 4 of 6 from the field and 2 for 4 from the line to finish with 12 points. S.J. Hutchinson II led the way for the Wolves with 20 points, seven rebounds and four assists. Cheyney (PA) also got 17 points and three steals from Treshawn Cody. Steven Hill finished with 11 points. Up next Delaware State plays Friday against Niagara at home, and Cheyney (PA) visits Temple on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
